question: What upper limits are declared for the height of the hall in this prescription?
premises: The hall height can extend up to the entablature.
The hall height can alternatively extend up to the neck.
This height specification is authoritatively declared.
inference: Therefore the hall height is declared to reach either the entablature or the neck.
uncertainties: The exact architectural identification of prastara and gala depends on technical convention.
plain_english: The height of the hall is declared to extend up to the entablature or up to the neck.
